PORT.name: PORT

ENCRYPTION_KEY.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Must match langfuse-web exactly — companion-referenced. Web and worker encrypt with the same key.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD

CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER_ENABLED.description: Single-node ClickHouse: disable cluster migrations so no ZooKeeper/Keeper is required.
